answer: A random beacon picks audit slots each epoch: chosen identities must answer a compute heartbeat within minutes, proving live work. Fakes arrive like a gale, but each needs its own heartbeat each epoch, costing 2 POA of compute. One hundred fakes burn 200 POA per epoch, plus a 50 POA bond each, slashed on a missed beat. Missed beats drag an identity to its nadir, then suspend it. An honest agent pays one heartbeat and keeps its rewards undiluted.
